title: chat_message avatar is not being served at the right prefix
body: ### Checklist - [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary When specifying avatar in the new `chat_message` function, it is not being served using full URL, like `st.image` does. As a result, when running behind proxy with a prefix (in my case in JupyterHub), the image could not be displayed. See the rendering for the dashboard provided below: ![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/8834829/bff4f5df-ad90-4bb4-a502-487da3ca9200) When I inspect both images, this is HTML I get 1. `st.image`: ``` ``` 2. `st.chat_message` ``` ``` If I manually modify the HTML in the developer console for the avatar element to include the full URL ``` ``` then it it works as expected: ![image](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/8834829/d48224cc-34b6-42fc-b8f1-05c8c3a07b45) So, I think the avatar should just use the full URL, if there are no objections to that. ### Reproducible Code Example ```Python import os import streamlit as st import numpy as np from PIL import Image dashboard_location = os.path.dirname(__file__) image = Image.open(dashboard_location + '/logo.png') st.image(image, caption='Logo') with st.chat_message("user", avatar=np.array(image)): st.write("Hello 👋") st.line_chart(np.random.randn(30, 3)) ``` ### Steps To Reproduce _No response_ ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Current Behavior _No response_ ### Is this a regression? - [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.24.0 - Python version: 3.9 - Operating System: Ubuntu - Browser: Edge on Mac ### Additional Information I searched where URL is being calculated in code and found this place: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/cf081f88bc4e25abb9130bf85c1e55e7b008e78d/lib/streamlit/elements/chat.py#L80 This would be my initial point of search to debug this error

comments.body: Hi [USER], thank you so much for sharing this issue! I do think this is expected behavior, but it makes sense that this would be problematic if you're using a proxy.

The `st.chat_message` avatar now uses the same prefix-aware media URL builder as `st.image` (`endpoints.buildMediaURL`, changed in #7130), so the avatar URL includes your `server.baseUrlPath` / proxy prefix correctly.

Closing as resolved — if you still see the wrong prefix on a current Streamlit version behind your proxy, please reopen and we'll dig in.
